verdict.rationale: The public pages offer a 'Search business database' lookup and certificate-of-good-standing validation, which suggest a founder can see an entity's standing. The only explicit status-check tool is 'Where's my refund? Check online' for state income tax returns, which sits on the tax.colorado.gov surface included in this corpus rather than the business-filing service. Missing for 10: a documented public lookup for the status of a pending business filing, application, or case; detail on what status fields the business search shows; hands-on corroboration that status lookup works.
